title: SHARED MACHINE POINTS
why: His 10-28 decision: both players get full points when both hurt a machine in its last 2.5 seconds. Watch: compare both score clocks after a shared machine kill, then wait over 2.5 seconds after one player hits and confirm only the finisher scores.
now: Recent machine contributors each receive full kill SP. Kill counts and kill rewards still belong to the finishing player.
